paragraphs: Greetings from the North Pole! The snow is sparkling, the reindeer are stamping their hooves with excitement, and the elves are humming carols as they work. I wanted to write to you myself, because I have heard some truly wonderful things about you this year.

Mrs Christmas told me that you learned to ride your bike all by yourself. Wobble, wobble, whoosh! Even Rudolph was impressed, and he can fly. I also heard how you helped Grandma plant bulbs in her garden, carefully patting down the soil. That was very kind and very patient of you.

The elves were especially pleased to hear how gentle you are with Rosie, and how you always remember to give Pickle a fresh bowl of water. Keep sharing your toys with Rosie, Oliver – it makes everyone at the North Pole smile.

I have read your letter about the space rocket, and the elves have pinned it up in the workshop where everyone can see it. Now, I must dash: there are mince pies to taste and a sleigh to polish before Christmas Eve.
Sleep tight on Christmas Eve, and have the happiest Christmas.
postscript: Rudolph says thank you in advance for the carrot!
signOff: With love from the North Pole,
